info.title: Acme Starter API
info.description: API REST protegida con Laravel Sanctum. Crea un token desde Ajustes → Tokens de API o con los endpoints de código de un solo uso (POST /v1/auth/otp y /v1/auth/otp/verify) y envíalo como `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description:
Always answers 202 with a `challenge_id`, whether the account exists
or not, so the endpoint cannot be used to discover accounts. Send the
challenge id with the code received by email to `/v1/auth/otp/verify`.
post.summary: Request a one-time code

challenge_id.description: Identifier of the challenge, required to verify the code.

resend_available_in.description: Seconds before another code can be requested for this email.

post.description:
Requires the `api.tokens.create` permission. Users with two-factor
authentication must also send `two_factor_code` or `recovery_code`.
post.summary: Exchange a one-time code for a token

device_name.description: A name to identify the device or integration using the token.

two_factor_code.description: Six digit code of the authenticator app (only when 2FA is enabled).

token.description: The plain text token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description:
Only available when the deployment enables passwords
(STARTER_AUTH_METHOD=email-otp+password).
post.summary: Create a token with email and password

token.description: The plain text token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description:
Requires `users.create`; only roles the caller can grant are accepted.
Users log in with one-time codes (passwords are only accepted when the
deployment enables them).

patch.description:
Requires `users.update`. Sending `roles` replaces the roles of the user
(not allowed on your own account; the last owner keeps the owner role).
Requires `users.disable`. Disabling revokes the sessions and tokens.

Requires `roles.manage`. The owner role cannot be modified and system
roles cannot be renamed.

delete.description: Requires `roles.manage`. System roles cannot be deleted.

Pass the returned `conversation_id` in the next request to keep the context.

post.description:
Returns the ranked passages (only from collections and documents your
access lists allow), the method, latency and the cost of embedding the
query (null when its price is unknown). Scores are rankings within a
method (cosine similarity, text rank or reciprocal rank fusion), not
probabilities. Requires `rag.playground.use`.
post.summary: Search the authorized knowledge

get.summary:
Knowledge analytics derived from real events: documents by status,
ingestion, queue and stage durations, errors, embedding and query
costs, retrieval latencies, outcomes, citations, feedback, freshness
and the latest evaluations. Requires `rag.analytics.read`

documents.description: Total, processed (finished, whatever the result) and eligible (searchable)...

get.summary: Evaluation sets with their latest run
An evaluation run with its metrics and per question results

Knowledge connections (internal, external PostgreSQL and retrieval
APIs) with their capabilities and last diagnostics. Credentials are
never returned. Requires `settings.update`

post.description:
Types url, sitemap, adapter and disk take a JSON `config`; files are
uploaded with multipart/form-data (`files[]`). Responds 202 with the
sync `job_id`.

Evaluate a set with retrieval settings (method, top_k, min_score,
max_context_tokens). Responds 202 with the run id; metrics: recall@k,
MRR, hit rate, no result rate, latency and cost

Run the diagnostics of a connection. Nothing is created or written
on an external database

Activate knowledge on a connection: diagnostics, schema provisioning
(managed and writable connections only) and the mode switch, only if
every check passes. Responds 422 with the report otherwise

SaveConnection.description:
Create or update a provider connection. Credentials are encrypted or
referenced from deployment secrets; blank secrets keep the stored ones.
SaveConnection.title: SaveConnection

SaveModel.description:
Import a model manually (with its source) or update a catalog entry.
Capabilities set here are recorded as manual decisions.
SaveModel.title: SaveModel

SaveSource.description: Creates (and syncs) or updates a source of a collection.

schedule.description: Automatic sync: hourly, daily or weekly (empty = manual).

SaveSource.title: SaveSource

SearchKnowledge.description:
Search the authorized knowledge (lab and API). The collections are
limited to those whose access list includes the actor; the retriever
applies the document access lists inside the query.

collection_ids.description: Collections to search (default: every collection you can access).

anyOf.description: vector, text or hybrid (default: the collection setting).

exact.description: Force exact (true) or approximate (false) vector search.

SearchKnowledge.title: SearchKnowledge

SetModelPrice.description:
Set (or stop) a manual price. A change creates a new version; costs
already recorded keep the price they were calculated with.

amount.description: Price in USD per unit (e.g. per million tokens). Empty to stop applying the price.

notes.description: Where the price comes from (URL of the price list, agreement...).

SetModelPrice.title: SetModelPrice
